0022600163.text: The 76ers (6-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) host the Bulls (1-5, 4th in the Central, 4 games back, 13th in the East) in Philadelphia's 8th game of the season, with the 76ers on a three-game winning streak and Chicago on a four-game losing streak. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Joel Embiid is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), while Dailyn Swain (back soreness), Jalen Smith (finger sprain) and Tobe Awaka (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the 76ers lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series, but Philadelphia won their last meeting 157-137 in Philadelphia on March 25.
